verdict.rationale: Atlas is a SaaS company-formation service, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question, and the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off services Atlas performs on the user's behalf, such as filing 83(b) elections and obtaining an EIN. It shows no capability for users to set up recurring or autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
